transcript: Accountability has revealed so many uncomfortable truths about myself to me. There is something about being able to see yourself through a mirror and really be able to see your internal world. Sit in acceptance, sit in appreciation, sit with who you are to the core with grace. Accountability is such a gift that has to be protected and preserved. Life changes immediately when you take accountability. Life changes when you see yourself for who you truly are. Accountability is not here to tear us down. Accountability is here to allow us the capacity to move on and move forward and move with acceptance.
